common:synonyms.#text: gravel sand; sand and gravel; gravelly sand

common:generalComment.#text: Gravel sand refers to aggregate of more or less rounded rock fragments coarser than sand, typically more than 2 mm in diameter. It is a natural material. Gravel is a widely used building material, often combined with a binding medium to form materials like asphalt concrete and Portland cement concrete. Crushed gravel is also available in various sizes for different applications, such as filling large holes.
砾石砂是指或多或少圆形岩石碎片的骨料，其比沙子更粗糙，通常直径超过2毫米。它是一种天然材料。砾石是一种广泛使用的建筑材料，通常与粘结介质结合形成沥青混凝土和硅酸盐水泥混凝土等材料。碎砾石也有各种尺寸可用于不同的应用，例如填充孔洞。
